name: ToolAlign
description: A dataset comprising instruction-tuning and preference data designed to align large language models with principles of helpfulness, harmlessness, and autonomy in tool use scenarios.
evaluation_method: human preference evaluation and task-specific alignment scoring
reputation: A niche alignment dataset used in research on tool-use safety and preference tuning, but not a widely standardized benchmark.
notes: Focuses on aligning LLMs for safe and autonomous tool use; includes supervised fine-tuning and preference learning.
